description: This is a PHP source file for an OpenCart admin controller that manages event settings, specifically related to updating tasks for language, currency, and location during the edit setting process.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: A controller class in the Opencart admin namespace responsible for handling event-related setting updates, particularly adding tasks for language, currency, and location.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked during the event, which adds specific tasks based on configuration when the route is not 'setting/setting.editSetting'.
